template.readme:
# Scheduler Sentiment Analysis Service

## Overview
GPU-accelerated sentiment analysis service using Ollama LLM for The Scheduler application.

## Features
- Real-time sentiment analysis of client communications
- Trigger word detection for staff alerts
- Deep analysis mode for complex cases
- HIPAA-compliant audit logging
- Multi-tenant support with business isolation

## Models
- **phi3:mini** (~8GB VRAM): Fast analysis, ~200ms latency
- **llama3.1:8b** (~16GB VRAM): Deep analysis, ~800ms latency

## GPU Requirements
- Minimum: 8GB VRAM (phi3:mini only)
- Recommended: 16GB+ VRAM (full functionality)

## Endpoints
- `GET /health/live` - Liveness check
- `GET /health/ready` - Readiness check (model loaded)
- `POST /api/v1/analyze` - Analyze text sentiment
- `POST /api/v1/batch` - Batch analysis

## Security
- API key authentication required
- CORS origin validation
- PHI redaction enabled
- Audit logging for HIPAA

## Configuration
Set environment variables in the RunPod dashboard:
1. `SENTIMENT_API_KEYS` - Your API keys
2. `SENTIMENT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` - Your app domains

## Support
Contact: support@example.com

pricing.notes: Cost varies by GPU type. A10G recommended for production.
